fields.Name: rerank-v3.5
fields.Description: Cohere Rerank v3.5 - Semantic reranking model with state-of-the-art performance for English content, optimized for RAG retrieval quality improvement. DEPRECATED 2026-07-01: starting 2026-08-01, requests to `cohere-rerank-3.5` are automatically routed to `cohere-rerank-4-fast` (which returns different relevance scores — re-tune hard-coded score thresholds before the switch). Migrate to `rerank-v4-fast` or `rerank-v4-pro` before August 1, 2026. Sources: https://docs.cohere.com/changelog/rerank-v4.0 ; https://docs.cohere.com/docs/deprecations

fields.Name: rerank-multilingual-v3.0
fields.Description: Cohere Rerank Multilingual v3.0 - Semantic reranking model supporting 100+ languages for global RAG deployments.

fields.Name: rerank-v4-pro
fields.Description: Cohere Rerank 4 Pro - Flagship semantic reranking model released December 16, 2025. 32K tokens per document, 100+ language support, and self-learning capabilities. Designed for maximum retrieval quality in demanding RAG workloads. Cohere standard pricing applies: $2.50 per 1,000 search units (not modeled here because rerank pricing does not map cleanly to Per-1M-Tokens unit types). API id corrected 2026-10-05: the callable id is `rerank-v4.0-pro`, not `rerank-v4-pro` - Cohere spells it with the ".0" in its own docs source (fern/pages/models/rerank-2.mdx, models.mdx and the 2025-12-11 rerank-v4 changelog). The record Name stays `rerank-v4-pro` because metadata/prompts/.default-rerank-prompt.json resolves it by name. Source: https://github.com/cohere-ai/cohere-developer-experience/blob/main/fern/pages/models/rerank-2.mdx

fields.Name: rerank-v4-fast
fields.Description: Cohere Rerank 4 Fast - Distilled, cost-efficient reranking model released December 16, 2025. 16K tokens per document, 100+ language support. Optimized for lower latency and higher throughput RAG pipelines where Rerank 4 Pro quality is not required. Cohere standard pricing applies: $1.50 per 1,000 search units (not modeled here because rerank pricing does not map cleanly to Per-1M-Tokens unit types). API id corrected 2026-10-05: the callable id is `rerank-v4.0-fast`, not `rerank-v4-fast` - Cohere spells it with the ".0" in its own docs source (fern/pages/models/rerank-2.mdx, models.mdx and the 2025-12-11 rerank-v4 changelog). The record Name stays `rerank-v4-fast` because metadata/prompts/.default-rerank-prompt.json resolves it by name. Source: https://github.com/cohere-ai/cohere-developer-experience/blob/main/fern/pages/models/rerank-2.mdx
